title: 3. Calidad y anomalías
description: Estado de salud de los medidores. Las lecturas a cero y los picos atípicos se calculan en el pipeline y se agregan por ventana; a este nivel emergen patrones que un evento aislado no revela, como los medidores muertos.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100.0 * sum(zero_count) / NULLIF(sum(event_count), 0) AS "pct ceros"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)

panels.title: Anomalías detectadas
panels.description: Lecturas con valor superior a p75 + 5 x IQR del mismo medidor.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100.0 * sum(anomaly_count) / NULLIF(sum(event_count), 0) AS "pct anomalías"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)

SELECT 100.0 * (sum(event_count) - sum(zero_count) - sum(anomaly_count)) / NULLIF(sum(event_count), 0) AS "pct válidas"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)

panels.title: Ceros y anomalías en el tiempo
panels.description: Una banda continua de ceros hora tras hora evidencia un medidor muerto.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(window_start, $__interval),
  sum(zero_count) AS "lecturas a cero",
  sum(anomaly_count) AS "anomalías"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Grupos con más lecturas a cero
panels.description: Candidatos a medidor muerto o fuera de servicio.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  site_id AS "Emplazamiento",
  primary_use AS "Uso de edificacion",
  meter_type AS "Tipo de medidor",
  sum(zero_count) AS "ceros",
  round(100.0 * sum(zero_count) / NULLIF(sum(event_count), 0), 1) AS "pct"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
HAVING sum(zero_count) > 0
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  window_start AS "ventana",
  site_id AS "Emplazamiento",
  primary_use AS "Uso de edificacion",
  meter_type AS "Tipo de medidor",
  anomaly_count AS "anomalías",
  event_count AS "lecturas",
  round(max_reading::numeric, 1) AS "lectura máxima"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND anomaly_count > 0
ORDER BY window_start DESC, anomaly_count DESC
LIMIT 50
